seller.offer_name: Outbound lead generation for M&A advisory firms
seller.seller_pov: Morton Street helps advisory firms win more mandates by solving add-on and bolt-on sourcing pain.
seller.outcome_hypothesis: The highest-value firms are the ones with visible specialization, constrained deal flow, and a hard time uncovering off-market or niche add-on targets.

buyer.company_query: M&A advisory firms with 2-10 headcount on LinkedIn
pain_hypotheses: The firm has specialization in a hard-to-source vertical.
The firm covers fragmented sectors where add-on discovery is labor intensive.
The firm needs stronger outbound origination or buyer-target mapping.
buyer.scoring_goal: Rank firms by likely pain around target discovery, origination, and niche deal sourcing.

roles.purpose: Daily deal operators who feel sourcing bottlenecks.
Directly exposed to pipeline and sourcing pressure.

scoring_factors.name: specialization_intensity
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the firm clearly focuses on sectors where add-on sourcing is non-trivial.

scoring_factors.name: deal_sourcing_pain
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the account likely struggles to find proprietary or niche targets.

scoring_factors.name: market_pressure
scoring_factors.description: Higher when macro conditions create urgency around pipeline quality or target finding.

scoring_factors.name: reachability
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the firm has visible leadership, active contacts, and enough public evidence for personalized outbound.
